svg.title: Public repo stars
svg.desc: Star history for sqlinjected/SQLab + 9 more repositories over all time. 42 current stars. 39 recorded additions in range. 2026-08-24 to 2026-11-15. Scale: absolute. Display intervals subdivide nominal API weeks; the final week may still be partial. Some weeks had no recorded data and were treated as zero.
